_help: One line per project. The name (e.g. project-a) is what engineers pick in the issue form's Project dropdown, or add as a GitHub label. projectKey = the Backlog project key. parentKey = optional Backlog issue that groups the engineering work (empty = none; Run workflow then skips this project, so sales issues are never copied to GitHub). Keep the names the same as the Project list in .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/engineering-task.yml.
